Arrival Checks for Companion Animals

If you are meeting an animal at the Aurelia Skyways terminal, keep your paperwork close and stay alert for updates from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Arrivals can move fast, and small delays are easier to handle when you know where to go and who to ask.

Milan Mendes, Andre Moretti, and Archie may all be used as a reminder that every arrival is handled with care. Our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and they avoid anything that could add stress. If your pet looks unsettled, keep your voice low and your movements slow.

<<FACT F095>> The staff will guide you through the next steps once the animal is ready for pickup. Bring any items you were told to present, and make sure the carrier or leash is secure before you approach the handoff area.

<<FACT F101>> The right staff member will review comfort needs and help sort out any concerns before release. If something seems off, say so right away. A quick note about eating, drinking, medication, or motion sensitivity can help the team respond properly.

Stay near the arrival point until you hear your name or see a clear signal from staff. Do not leave the area if you are unsure whether the transfer is complete. If weather, crowding, or terminal changes affect the handoff, the team will direct you to the safest option.

Keep your phone on and check for messages from Aurelia Skyways. If you are traveling with more than one animal, wait for each release to be confirmed before moving on. A calm, steady pickup makes the whole arrival easier for everyone involved.

If you still need help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away for direct guidance.
